distribution: embedded in desktop executable; no runtime download

energy.origin: Independent Rust implementation of observed local acoustic calculation in Lexicon 1.11.15.0
energy.output: one integer rating 1-10; no rating for digital silence or less than one frame

energy_window_classifier.origin: RBF SVC fitted to window levels returned by the licensed application for the development split; embedded in the desktop executable, never downloaded
energy_window_classifier.input: 183-value energy windows from the canonical 44.1 kHz stereo PCM
energy_window_classifier.output: one integer rating 1-10 (80th percentile of window levels)
